## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(gganimate)
```
```{r}
# data clearning
sim_data <- sim_data_raw %>%
  mutate(
    color = paste("#", color, sep = ""),
    passiveEnergyChange = autoGen - energyConsumption
  )

sim_data <- sim_data %>% filter(color != "#")
```

```{r}
plot_theme <- theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'black'),
      panel.grid = element_line(colour = 'grey20'),
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      title = element_text(size = 14, family = 'mono')
    )

plot_theme_light <- theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'white'),
      panel.grid = element_line(colour = 'grey90'),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = 'grey80'),
      title = element_text(size = 14, family = 'mono'),
    )
```


```{r}
population_size <- sim_data %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

ggplot(data = population_size, aes(time, count)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Total creature count by time") +
  plot_theme_light
```

```{r}
anim_length = 20
plot_data <- sim_data %>%
  filter(time %% 40 == 0) %>%
  mutate(passiveEnergyChange = autoGen - energyConsumption) %>%
  select(time, speed, size, passiveEnergyChange, color)

nframes <- length(unique(plot_data$time))
fps <- round(nframes / anim_length)
p1 <- plot_data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y =size, colour = color)) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    geom_point() +
    plot_theme + 
    labs(title = "Time: {round(frame_time, 0)}", x = 'speed', y = 'size') +
    transition_time(time) +
    ease_aes('linear')

animate(p1, width = 800, height = 800, nframes = nframes, fps = fps)
anim_save('plot_speed_size_sped');
```


```{r}
sim_data %>% 
  mutate(passiveEnergyChange = autoGen - energyConsumption) %>%
  filter(time > 12000) %>%
  select(time, speed, size, passiveEnergyChange, energyConsumption, autoGen, color) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y =size, colour = passiveEnergyChange)) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_colour_gradient2(
      low = 'red',
      mid = 'white',
      high = 'green',
      midpoint = 0
    ) +
    plot_theme

ggsave("plot_passive_energy_with_low_split_threshold.png")
```
```{r}
sim_data %>%
  filter(time > 10000 & time %% 500 == 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = size, color = splitThresh)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Energy before reproduction increases as size increases") +
  plot_theme_light
```
```{r}
sim_data %>%
  filter(time == 12000) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = detectRange)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Detection Range Increases with Speed") +
  geom_smooth(method = 'lm') +
  plot_theme_light
```
```{r}
sim_data %>%
  filter(time %% 100 == 0) %>%
  group_by(time, type =ifelse(passiveEnergyChange < 0, "heterotroph", 'autotroph')) %>%
  summarise(meanDetectRange = mean(detectRange)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = meanDetectRange, color = type)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Detection Range Increases with Speed") +
  plot_theme_light
```

```{r}
sim_data %>%
  filter(time %% 100 == 0) %>%
  group_by(time, type =ifelse(passiveEnergyChange < 0, "heterotroph", 'autotroph')) %>%
  summarise(meanSplitThresh = mean(splitThresh)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = meanSplitThresh, color = type)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Split Threshold") +
  plot_theme_light
```
